Container.Name: fpkg-builder-webui
Container.Overview: WebUI wrapper for fPKG Builder with archive import workflow. Mount your input share, appdata, and output folder into the container.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the fPKG Builder WebUI. Container port stays 8080.

Config.Name: Source Share
Config.Description: Source share for ZIP/RAR/7z archives, folder dumps, backports and base PKGs.

Config.Name: PS5 Output Share
Config.Description: Default PS5 share for generated packages and output files.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Appdata folder for settings, imports and temporary work files.

Config.Name: FPKG_REPO_ROOT
Config.Description: Path to the fPKG Builder repository inside the container.

Config.Name: FPKG_POWERSHELL
Config.Description: PowerShell executable used by the WebUI runner.

Config.Name: FPKG_IMPORT_ROOT
Config.Description: Container path for temporary archive imports selected in the WebUI.

Config.Name: FPKG_BROWSE_ROOTS
Config.Description: Colon-separated container paths the WebUI file browser may browse.
